meta.title: Workbench
meta.description: The sidebar Workbench page plus a Workbench section in Settings: boards and sub-boards, the working-area directory, and each board's multi-select prompt and skill switches — saved settings apply to the workbench immediately. The workbench is a private shelf: cloth covers, a row of mini cover fronts, an inner page and a today drawer; every function and the data contract stay intact.
